description: A Kivy-based graphical demonstration for tessellating polygons, including user interaction and mesh rendering.

classes.name: ShapeBuilder
classes.description: A Kivy FloatLayout subclass managing user-drawn shapes and tessellation rendering.

classes.name: TessApp
classes.description: A Kivy App subclass that initializes and runs the tessellation demonstration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ShapeBuilder, setting up default shapes and building the initial tessellation.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch down events, adding points to the current shape.

methods.name: on_touch_move
methods.description: Handles touch move events, updating the current shape with new points.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch up events, finalizing the current shape and triggering tessellation.

methods.name: push_shape
methods.description: Adds the current shape to the list of shapes and resets the current shape.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Performs tessellation of all shapes and updates the visual mesh, with optional debug visualization.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all shapes and resets the display status.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and runs the Kivy application.
